name: Team
description: Element type that shows the members of one or more groups as a team page: name, description (Markdown/HTML), choice of the attributes shown (photo, job title, department, e-mail, phone, office, about, groups or attributes from the identity provider), as cards, list or table.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Show contact details publicly
permissions.description: Let guests see the contact details on team pages (e-mail, phone, mobile, office, about, groups and attributes of the identity provider).
